device.type: DVB-S2 HD satellite receiver with USB PVR, CI/CA and Ethernet
device.soc: ALi S3606H / M3606C (dual-CPU C3603-family DVB-S2 SoC, chip ID 0x3603; Libcore 7.3.0@SDK4.0ba.7.3_20120215, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0ba.7.1_SAB_S2_20111227bynbree)
device.demod: ALi M3501 / S3501 on SCB1 at I2C 0x33
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 on SCB1 at I2C 0x63

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the official download)
source.author: Openbox
source.note: Archive S16_ENG_2.7.abs from OPENBOX S16; added for expanded coverage.

simulator.note: Boots as the dual-CPU M3602 family with device.chipId 0x3603 (C3603), device.demodModel s3501@0x33 and device.tunerModel av2011@0x63: the bootloader parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1E8F7C0, unpacks the 2.42 MB seecode ("M3606 SEE") and 5.24 MB maincode ("S3606H-1.0.0"), and starts the SEE program on the second core at 0xA6000200 (EBase 0x80000001).  The application initialises S3501 and probes AV2011 on SCB1, drives the TM1650-compatible front panel on GPIO 62 / 63 (" on " -> "noCH"), and renders its 16-bpp ARGB1555 "Edit Channel" main menu OSD (14 GE commands, 1,832 unique colours), where DOWN on its 0x80xx remote table ("necfirst" coding) steps to "Installation".

desc: Openbox S16 EU firmware Eu1129 (OPENBOX-S16_Eu1129.abs, 2012-11-28) for the European ALi S3606H / M3606C dual-CPU hardware revision of the Openbox S16 HD PVR on a 4 MB SPI flash.

Unlike the single-CPU M3601S Chinese build (S16_CHN_2.8.abs, remote table 0x01xx with preloaded channels), this dual-CPU S3606H European build runs its 2.42 MB "M3606 SEE" co-processor image on the second core at 0xA6000200, ships an empty user database ("noCH"), and uses a 54-key European remote table at 0x80xx.
